agent.name: Emerging Technology Diffusion Agent
agent.specialty: Diffusion evidence, mechanisms and contextual timing

analytical_question: How far has generative AI and this reporting application diffused, what mechanisms matter, and how should organizational posture change the timing of further investigation?
general_et_finding: Conservative posture does not make generative AI less diffused. The unchanged RPS evidence supports broad but uneven U.S. workplace use: 40.55% work use and 34.84% last-week use in Q3 2026, lower than Q2 but higher than a year earlier. The unit is employed adults aged 18-64. The series are related survey prevalence measures, not cumulative first adopters, retained cohorts or retail firms. Exact Rogers stage and the cause or significance of the quarterly decline remain unresolved.
application_finding: No source establishes the share of comparable online clothing retailers repeatedly using AI for weekly sales narratives. Application-stage abstention remains warranted; lack of data is not evidence of rare use. The hypothetical firm has not deployed this workflow. Five-factor assessment: Relative advantage [inference/unknown]: drafting may be faster than manual templates, but compare total drafting, review and correction time at equivalent factual quality. Compatibility [case fact plus inference]: SQL tables and existing report templates provide a starting point, while an unapproved production data route limits fit; inspect data transfer, roles and accountability. Complexity [inference]: checking explanations and integrating output into weekly work are the likely dominant bottleneck despite easy text entry; observe experienced and ordinary analysts using the workflow. Trialability [case fact/inference]: a reversible draft-only exercise using synthetic or approved non-sensitive tables is feasible in principle; verify scope, access and reviewer capacity first. Observability [unknown]: no representative peer-use or local outcome evidence exists; require transparent results, unsuccessful attempts and repeated use rather than polished demonstrations. None of these are measured perceptions of actual employees.
organization_specific_finding: A conservative posture resembles a late-majority-style preference for established peer proof; it does not establish a late adopter rank or justify labeling employees as resistant. Give priority to collecting credible comparable references and resolving workflow evidence gaps before seeking authorization for an internal trial. Continue monitoring instead of assuming that waiting has no opportunity cost. Actor/ecosystem interpretation [proposed mechanisms, not observed effects]: an analyst trainer or implementation coordinator could act as change agent by helping users practice; a respected reviewer could be an opinion leader only if colleagues actually seek and trust that person's advice. Check interviews and advice networks before assigning those roles. User communities can share examples and failures but are self-selected; vendor training may reduce setup effort while overstating benefits. Verified tables, training, review capacity and a compatible data route are complementary assets. No specific interoperability standard, certification or network effect has been verified.

evidence.claim: Current work use and last-week use describe different behaviors in the same individual-level survey.
evidence.evidence_type: Original survey series; rounding and differences are analyst calculations
evidence.notes: U.S. employed adults aged 18-64; point estimates, not a firm/application curve or longitudinal retention.

evidence.claim: Business statistics and regional barriers add context without measuring this application.
evidence.source_or_reference: S3 Census May 2026 report; S4 St. Louis Fed July 2026 report; see source_register.json for locations
evidence.evidence_type: Original national and regional survey reports
evidence.notes: Broader AI scope; different populations/windows. S3 historical snapshot is not current October business prevalence. S4 is not nationally representative retail evidence.

evidence.claim: Five-factor mapping and actor roles guide evidence requests rather than prove a cause.
evidence.source_or_reference: S0 Rogers (1983), Chapters 1 and 7; C0 supplied course memo and reading
evidence.date_or_recency: Framework source; no current prevalence implied
evidence.evidence_type: Theory plus analyst inference from synthetic case facts
evidence.notes: No numeric score, threshold-based stage assignment, observed staff perceptions or named influential person is claimed.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: The latest quarterly point estimates are below Q2, so growth is not monotonic; no supplied confidence interval or causal identification supports declaring a reversal.
Recent individual use can coexist with shallow or incomplete workflow integration. Missing peer-task evidence prevents claiming early-majority retail reporting.
A simple interface may still require difficult verification; perceived advantage and staff acceptance are unmeasured.
RPS series are related, not independent confirmation. Census broader AI scope and question change prevent a stitched growth series.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in substantial but uneven U.S. workplace diffusion; low confidence in an exact Rogers category and no supported peer-application rate. The prioritization of verification/workflow complexity is a case inference, not a survey result. Posture does not change general confidence.
value_opportunity_implication: If an evaluation is separately authorized, propose tracking all eligible analysts over four weekly reporting cycles: eligible count, attempted and completed reports, repeat participation, abandoned attempts, errors, and total drafting/review/correction time. Include less experienced users. Four cycles is an analyst-designed diagnostic window, not a universal diffusion threshold or proof of long-term retention. Comparable peer references can explain mechanisms; estimate peer prevalence only with a defensible sampling frame.
risk_governance_implication: Diffusion does not establish task reliability or net value. No production data route is approved in the scenario. Keep learning inputs synthetic or approved, calculations in verified systems and human review accountable. Pass safeguards and deployment authorization to the appropriate experts.
recommendation_management_implication: Timing implication: sequence peer and workflow evidence before a trial proposal and revisit within the three-month horizon or when credible new evidence arrives. This is an evidence-sequencing recommendation, not the full adoption/defer decision. Minimum data protection, review and quality requirements stay unchanged.
change_monitoring_triggers: Next comparable RPS release, revisions or question changes; compare both quarter-over-quarter and year-over-year evidence.
Representative evidence of repeated use of this exact task in the defined retail peer group.
Observed repeat participation, task completion, errors and total effort from a separately approved evaluation.
Verified peer advice networks, reviewer capacity or data-route changes that alter compatibility and observability.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Withhold an exact peer-application diffusion stage and any claim that the chasm is crossed.
Request a stable peer denominator, geography, company size, task definition, observation window and repeated-use measure.
Request evidence of retention before interpreting current-use changes as individual dropout; request uncertainty estimates before declaring a significant quarterly shift.
Full adoption and rollout decisions belong to the Adoption Agent and management.
